tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The whole platform sits on plain white. No tinted grounds.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells only: the chat composer, inactive tabs, the canvas backdrop behind document pages.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, headings, doodles and hand-drawn outlines (18:1 on `paper`).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, helper copy on `paper` (6.5:1) and `paper-sunk` (5.9:1).

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Meaningful thin lines: input borders, inactive tab outlines, connector lines (3.4:1). Never text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decoration only: dividers, ruled lines, the dot grid on the canvas.

tokens.name: safety
tokens.usage: Hi-vis orange. Primary action fill, active tool, SR. Fill or mark only, never text on white (3.2:1).

tokens.name: on-safety
tokens.usage: Text on `safety` (6:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Links, focus ring, MR, AI notes in the margin. Text-safe on white (5.9:1).

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on a `blue` fill.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Approved, done, PEP, accepted AI edits. Text-safe (5:1). Pair with a word or check.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on a `green` fill.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: On hold, delete, rejected AI edits. Text-safe (4.6:1). Always with a word or cross.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on a `red` fill.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Sticker and folder accent only.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Sticker accent only.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Warnings and caution flags, with `ink` text.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlighter pen and the user's selection in the canvas. Text stays `ink`.

tokens.name: sticky-yellow
tokens.usage: Default sticky note body.

tokens.name: sticky-yellow-top
tokens.usage: The darker glue band at the top of a yellow sticky note.

tokens.name: sticky-peach
tokens.usage: Second note in a stack, or questions.

tokens.name: sticky-green
tokens.usage: Third note in a stack, or decisions.

tokens.name: folder-pink
tokens.usage: Folder colour. Each document type or project gets one.

tokens.name: folder-sage
tokens.usage: Folder colour.

tokens.name: folder-peach
tokens.usage: Folder colour.

tokens.name: folder-butter
tokens.usage: Folder colour.

tokens.name: folder-lilac
tokens.usage: Folder colour.

tokens.name: folder-sky
tokens.usage: Folder colour.

tokens.name: on-sticky
tokens.usage: All text on sticky notes, folders and sticker bodies.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the page title, HeyTea style, lots of air around it.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers, empty states, the doc-ready moment.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Folder names, storefront headings, modal titles.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: send the soil report by Friday
styles.usage: Sticky note body; quiet words in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: note-strong
styles.usage: The one or two words on a sticky note that matter.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Folder names, storefront signs, sticker-like labels, one accent word in a headline.

styles.name: aside
styles.usage: The AI's voice in the margin: its name, asides, margin notes beside edits. Usually `blue`.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Woset-style big grotesk for page openers and menus. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Document section headings and panel titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: What's the expected soil class at the site?
styles.usage: Chat messages, document body, form answers.

styles.name: doc-id
styles.usage: Document numbers and revisions. Use tabular figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`).

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above fields, step counters, title blocks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between stacked labels and fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical 10, horizontal 18 is the one exception), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gap between chat messages.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and sticky note padding, gap between sections in a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major blocks, document page margin.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Air above and below display type.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top padding, around the hero line on a quiet screen.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Stamps, doc tags, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Inputs, cards, menus.

tokens.name: radius-folder
tokens.usage: Folder bodies and tabs.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Chat panel, sheets, user message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips and toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Things stuck onto the page: sticky notes, stickers, a dragged item.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Document pages on the canvas, the glassy folder, popovers.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Ruled lines, dividers, secondary outlines.

tokens.name: stroke-ink
tokens.usage: Hand-drawn control outlines: buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: stroke-marker
tokens.usage: Doodles, the sketchpen tool default, emphasis underlines.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Panels, tabs, sticky note pick-up.

tokens.name: dur-draw
tokens.usage: A doodle or underline drawing itself in (stroke-dashoffset).

tokens.name: dur-flip
tokens.usage: One page turn in the doc-ready flip-book.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything entering.

tokens.name: ease-slap
tokens.usage: A sticker or stamp landing: slight overshoot, like slapping it onto paper.
